title: Critical local smoothing for the three-dimensional wave equation
summary: We prove the critical L 3 local smoothing estimate for the wave equation in three spatial dimensions, with every positive Sobolev loss. This resolves Sogge's Euclidean local smoothing conjecture in dimension three.

review.reason: Proves critical L³ local smoothing for the 3D wave equation, resolving Sogge's conjecture in dimension three.
